verdict.rationale: Temporal's CLI (`temporal server start-dev`, `temporal workflow list`, `temporal operator namespace list`) and self-hosted Docker/Kubernetes deployment guides show the server and workers can be started and controlled entirely from the command line without a GUI, which is what CI/automation pipelines need; the GitHub docs also show pre-built Docker images that can be spun up non-interactively for CI test runs. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples/config (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow files) and independent confirmation of headless CI usage beyond docs.
